abstract: “To workflow: the cause of and solution to all of life’s problems!” Borrowing from Homer Simpson at his finest, I once toasted my colleagues at the end of a long day during my tenure as a workflow supervisor with this phrase. Among us, we had a smattering of improvised vessels to hold our whisky—paper cups, actual glasses, even a few coffee-stained mugs—to further illustrate our ability to “make it work” no matter what.

authors.bio: Kylee Peña is a media and entertainment technology polymath who loves enabling people through project and program management, design thinking, and storytelling. She is currently Manager, Creative Technologies Program Management at Netflix and leads a nonprofit, supporting women over 30 who shift to STEM careers. She was first published in the Motion Imaging Journal in 2018 and has served as a SMPTE Hollywood Section Manager, the Annual Technical Conference Programming Co-Chair, and will serve as the Hollywood Region Governor for 2022–2023. Her undergraduate studies were in video production and computer science, and she is currently pursuing a master’s in integrated design, business, and technology at University of Southern California (USC), Los Angeles, CA.
